title: Idle Seats and the Professional Email Seat Catch-Up
content:
Account management guidance. On a Professional Email seat catch-up the catch-up target — the seats the current term should carry — turns on the idle seats.

The idle seats of a seat catch-up are the mailbox deletions recorded on the subscription in the current term less the restores of those deletions, a deletion counting in the current term, and its restore with it, where the whole calendar months from the deletion date to today are no more than the whole calendar months from the term start date to today.

- Where a scheduled seat count is set, the catch-up target is the lower of the scheduled seat count and the seat count on the subscription, but never fewer than the mailboxes in use, the seat count less the idle seats.
- Where no scheduled seat count is set and the idle seats are above zero, it is the seat count less the idle seats.
- Otherwise it is the seat count on the subscription, every licensed seat being billed.

## Cases (hypothetical subscription: seat count 41)

| Idle seats | Scheduled seat count | Catch-up target |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | none | 39 |
| 2 | 37 | the lower of 37 and 41 is 37, never fewer than 39 in use: 39 |
| 2 | 40 | 40 |
| 0 | none | 41 |

Counting example (hypothetical): term start 15 January, today 3 October, 8 whole calendar months; a deletion on 1 February (8 whole months) counts, a deletion on 10 January, also 8 whole months, counts as well, and a deletion on 2 January (9 whole months) does not.
